Title 42 Public Health Order vs. Title 8 Enforcement Consequences

Under Title 42 Public Health Order Enforcement: Expulsion from the U.S. to Mexico for certain nationalities or to home countries, without consequences for future migration.

Consequences under Title 8 Enforcement: Placed into immigration removal proceedings. Rapid removal from the U.S. to Mexico or home country. Barred from reentering the U.S. for at least 5 years, if removed. Criminally prosecuted for illegal reentry after removal from the U.S.
